test_title: PYST 19: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The manager asked me __if I have completed my projects__.

options.text: if he has completed my projects
if I has completed my projects
if I had completed my projects
if I shall have completed my projects

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the singular form of the verb 'have' is incorrect.
 
• The verb form **"had"** is used because the sentence is in the **past perfect tense**.
 
• The manager's question about the completion of projects refers to an action that was completed before another action in the past (the moment the manager asked).
 
• Hence, **"had completed"** correctly indicates that the projects were finished prior to being asked.
 
• Therefore, the past perfect form of the verb 'had' should be used in place of the present perfect form 'have'.

Correct sentence: *The manager asked me if I **had completed** my projects*.
